data.name: FrameRateTip
data.value: Native: the game runs as on the Vita. Locked to 30/60: every frame lasts 2 or 1 vblank (e.g. a game at 20 fps goes to 30). Unlimited: no vblank wait, the game runs as fast as the PC allows. Games whose logic advances per frame get faster or slower with this (speed, physics, music out of sync); if that happens, go back to Native. While the game runs, F2 / Shift+F2 change the rate for that session only.
